title: Potential estimates and improved Sobolev regularity for nonlocal fully nonlinear elliptic equations
summary: This paper investigates pointwise and oscillatory potential estimates for viscosity solutions and their gradients to a class of nonlocal fully nonlinear elliptic equations. The key ingredient of our argument is to establish precise pointwise bounds for a novel fractional sharp maximal function defined in terms of affine functions. As an immediate consequence, we prove higher order Sobolev regularity results of Calderón-Zygmund type for such equations without imposing any global boundedness assumptions on viscosity solutions.
